entities.summary: Maxim Birbraer is a Kazakhstani-born Israeli former professional ice hockey forward. Birbraer is Jewish and has played for the Israel national ice hockey team. Since June 2025, Birbraer has been the President and General Manager of Elite Ice Hockey League side Fife Flyers.
